title: Pre-registration register: every rule, its window, and the commit that froze it

history_scope.consequence: an anchor is either resolved from a commit this checkout can read, carried forward from a register built where history was visible, or left blank - never guessed from the boundary commit

rows.name: Week 11 pre-kickoff escrow: three markets, two total estimators, official settlement only
rows.markets: side, then total (published twice: total_A league floor, total_B two-club), then moneyline - the order is a build constraint in tools/lab/build_escrow.py
rows.window: 2026 REG week 11, recorded 2026-11-17 before the first kickoff (2026-11-19 8:15 PM ET); ratings read from the 150-game official corpus, market line withheld (Q-02)
rows.leaderboard_eligible: no - a prospective record qualifies for the second stage; it is not ranked against a strategy competing for a reward, and no CLV or ROI is computed because there is no price source
rows.gates: G1 registered before the window opens; G2 chronology (the escrow rows' fixture must not have been played when the record was written, and the record's clock comes from the reads pack, not the build clock); G3 proper scores with n printed; G4 no multiplicity claim - one record, no variant search; G5 staking and CLV withheld (no price source)
rows.registration_subject: PR-04: Week 11 pre-kickoff escrow - rule file, builder, 52 forecast rows (side/total_A/total_B/moneyline, market line withheld on Q-02) and the settlement ledger that scores PR-01's own record from official finals (W-3)
rows.verification_note: The register stores the SHA-256 of the rule file as committed. Rebuild this register at any time: if the hash of the rule file no longer matches the text the entry says was frozen, the rule was edited after it saw data.

limits: This checkout is a shallow clone (oldest visible commit 38816a6200), so a rule that predates it cannot have its anchor re-derived here; those rows carry the value recorded by a full-history build and say so in `anchor_carried_forward`. COORDINATION.md records PR-02's rule as registered by commit 0747005 and PR-01's by 25221eb, neither of which this checkout can read: they are cited as the prior's statement, not verified here.

The anchor is the first commit that touched the file on THIS branch. A squashed merge would rewrite it, and the site's own history contains squash merges, so the anchor is a strong convention, not a tamper-proof seal.
docs/lab/control-baselines.md was registered by another session; this register indexes it rather than restating it, so the rule text a reader evaluates against is the only copy.
